about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: S1 adds internal links from real fairway wood pages to six pages (Aldila, Fujikura, True Temper) that look like shaft listings filed as fairway woods at £59.99-£69.99, i.e. wrong-category products.
points: data/agent-links.json: aldila-/fujikura-/true-temper-*-fairway-wood pages are named after shaft brands and flexes (e.g. 'Aldila Regular Fairway Wood' from £59.99 at one shop), so they look like shafts mis-filed as fairway woods; linking from Callaway/Titleist/Srixon fairway wood pages promotes them. Fix: skip S1's six shaft entries (keep odyssey-trtl-ch-putter) and have the catalogue agent re-categorise or hide those pages.
data/agent-links.json: all six shaft entries use an identical 'from' list, so the same six pages get six near-duplicate links.
S3 (fourball/episodes): not in the diff and fourball/episodes does not exist in the repo, so the episode could not be reviewed; check it before merging.
llms.txt: figures (3,297 models, 323 cheaper this week, new lowest prices) cannot be verified from the diff alone; wording and £ formatting are fine.
data/agent-rules.json: hiding BOSS Infinity Long John for 3 days (403 buy link) and dropping expired rules look fine.
